EN: We gotta stop the carrot tops!
ZH: 我们必须阻止那些长者胡萝卜颜色头发的家伙们！

EN: What do you say?
ZH: 你们觉得怎么样？

EN: Why such hate for redheads?
ZH: 为什么这样讨厌红头发？

EN: I say you care way too much about hair color.
ZH: 我想说你太在乎头发颜色了。

EN: I say it's time to get all Saint Paddy on you Snakes!
ZH: 我说是时候让所有的爱尔兰人对付你们这些蛇了！

EN: A band of Raiders known as the Snakes has been targeting Settlers with red hair, calling them “gingers” and claiming they are inferior beings. We need to drive these Snakes out of the neighborhood, for good!
ZH: 一伙被称为“蛇”的掠夺者正在针对红头发的定居者，称他们为“生姜”，声称他们是下等人种。我们得把这些人赶走。

EN: Driving the Snakes Out
ZH: 把“蛇”赶出去

EN: Defeat the Raider Boss.
ZH: 打败掠夺者首领。

EN: Defeat the Raiders.
ZH: 击败掠夺者。

EN: Defeat the Raiders.
ZH: 击败掠夺者。

EN: Defeat a band of Raiders hostile to redheads.
ZH: 打败一伙敌视红发人的掠夺者。

EN: You know, someone told me Alpha Deathclaws are an endangered species...
ZH: 话说有人告诉我领头死爪是濒临灭绝的物种……

EN: Well, we're all going to be endangered if you don't take those monsters down!
ZH: 呃，你们要是不除掉那些怪兽，我们全都得濒危！

EN: Two Alpha Deathclaws have decided to make their home at the old Grotton Depot. Yikes! Time to bring out the big guns!
ZH: 两只领头死爪决定把旧的格罗顿仓库当做他们的家。太可怕！是时候拿出大家伙（枪）了！

EN: Duo of Destruction: Alpha Deathclaws
ZH: 双重毁灭：领头死爪

EN: Kill the first Alpha Deathclaw.
ZH: 消灭第一只领头死爪。

EN: Kill the second Alpha Deathclaw.
ZH: 消灭第二只领头死爪。

EN: Put down an angry pair of Alpha Deathclaws!
ZH: 放倒一对发怒的领头死爪！

EN: Gosh. I could see the glow halfway across the waste. Good luck in there.
ZH: 天。隔着大半个废土都能看见那绿光。上帝保佑。

EN: A pair of Glowing Ones have taken over an old Fusion Core factory. Toss those Ghouls out on their keisters!
ZH: 两只发光种占领了一处旧的聚变核心工厂。赶紧解决掉他们。

EN: Duo of Destruction: Glowing One (x2!)
ZH: 双重毁灭：发光种(x2!)

EN: Eliminate the first Glowing One.
ZH: 除掉第一只发光种。

EN: Eliminate the second Glowing One.
ZH: 除掉第二只发光种。

EN: Put down the pair of Glowing Ones at the old Fusion Core factory!
ZH: 拿下旧聚变核心工厂的一对发光种！

EN: Those roaches are wrecking our home! Please! Get rid of 'em!
ZH: 这些蟑螂正在破坏我们的家！消灭它们！

EN: Two Glowing Radroaches have chased the residents of the “Nuclear Arms Apartments” out of their home. Time for a little exterminating.
ZH: 两只发光辐射蟑螂把“核子武器公寓”的居民赶出了家门。是时候杀杀虫了。

EN: Duo of Destruction: Glowing Radroaches
ZH: 双重毁灭：发光辐射蟑螂

EN: Eliminate the first Glowing Radroach.
ZH: 除掉第一只发光辐射蟑螂。

EN: Eliminate the second Glowing Radroach.
ZH: 除掉第二只发光辐射蟑螂。

EN: Exterminate the pair of Glowing Radroaches residing at the Nuclear Arms Apartments!
ZH: 消灭核子武器公寓里的发光辐射蟑螂！

EN: Thank goodness you're here! We're no match for those chitinous creeps! Take them down for us? Please?
ZH: 谢天谢地你在这里！我们可不是这些硬壳怪物的对手！能帮我们消灭它们吗？求求你们了！

EN: Two Glowing Radscorpions are causing havoc in Vault 512! Squash those bugs good!
ZH: 两只发光辐射蝎正在512号避难所里兴风作浪！赶紧碾压这些害虫们！

EN: Duo of Destruction: Glowing Radscorpions
ZH: 双重毁灭：发光辐射蝎

EN: Eliminate the first Glowing Radscorpion.
ZH: 消灭第一只发光辐射蝎。

EN: Eliminate the second Glowing Radscorpion.
ZH: 消灭第二只发光辐射蝎。

EN: Exterminate both of the Glowing Radscorpions in Vault 512!
ZH: 消灭512号避难所里的两只发光辐射蝎！

EN: If you came for the dog food, you're out of luck. Those momma Mole rats were hungry. Take care of them, will ya?
ZH: 如果你们是为了狗粮来的，那么可不走运了。那些鼹鼠妈妈可是饿了，你们帮我们解决下吧？

EN: Two Mole rat brood mothers have been spotted at the nearby dog food factory. It's about time someone took them down.
ZH: 两只鼹鼠妈妈被发现出现在了附近的狗粮工厂。是时候有人拿下它们了。

EN: Duo of Destruction: Mole Rat Brood Mothers
ZH: 双重毁灭：鼹鼠妈妈

EN: Eliminate the first Mole rat brood mother.
ZH: 除掉第一只鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Eliminate the second Mole rat brood mother.
ZH: 除掉第二只鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Eliminate the two Mole rat brood mothers at the old dog food factory!
ZH: 消灭旧狗粮工厂里的两只鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Dig for GOLD! It's your patriotic duty!
ZH: 挖金子去！这可是爱国职责！

EN: Nothing is more important than the National Gold Reserves!
ZH: 没有什么比国家黄金储备更重要的了！

EN: Ask not what your country can do for you, but how you can GET MORE GOLD for your country!
ZH: 不要问国家能为你做什么，问问你能为国家多搞到多少黄金！

EN: We've discovered the remains of a secret Enclave base. What strange and horrifying stuff will we find?
ZH: 我们发现了一座秘密英克雷基地的遗址。不知道能找到什么奇怪又骇人的东西？

EN: Golden Neighbors
ZH: 黄金好邻居

EN: Look for valuables
ZH: 寻找贵重物品

EN: Look for clues about the Enclave
ZH: 寻找关于英克雷的线索

EN: Explore a ruined Enclave base nearby.
ZH: 探索附近一座废弃的英克雷基地。

EN: I still can't believe there was an Enclave base so close to our vault.
ZH: 我还是不敢相信，离我们避难所这么近就有一座英克雷基地。

EN: And we get to explore it!
ZH: 而我们还能去探索它！

EN: Let's look for treasure. And intel. The top secret kind.
ZH: 我们找找财宝吧。还有情报。那种绝密的情报。

EN: Why are those eyebots going on about gold?
ZH: 为什么那些眼球机器人一直在唠叨黄金的事？

EN: I mean, gold is strategic commodity, but someone must be really obsessed with the metal.
ZH: 我是说，黄金确实是战略物资，但肯定有人对这金属着了魔。

EN: Let's see if we can find any clues…
ZH: 我们看看能不能找到什么线索……

EN: Rrraaawwrgggh!
ZH: 嗷嗷嗷！

EN: Hey, those Mole rats have a nest made of old clothes. Let's take them!
ZH: 嘿，那些鼹鼠有个用旧衣服搭的窝。咱们拿走吧！

EN: GOLD! In case you weren't aware, it's the best!
ZH: 金子！要是你还不清楚，告诉你，它是最棒的！

EN: Beautiful and practical, truly the ultimate material!
ZH: 美丽又实用，真是终极材料！

EN: Friendly reminder that the Enclave is a secret. Don't tell anyone!
ZH: 友善提醒，英克雷是个秘密。别告诉任何人！

EN: Take all gold to the National Gold Reserves, or face heavy prosecution!
ZH: 将所有黄金上缴国家黄金储备，否则将面临严厉起诉！

EN: Gold is good for wires, not much else.
ZH: 黄金嘛，做电线挺好，别的用处不大。

EN: The Enclave is active?
ZH: 英克雷还活跃着？

EN: I love gold! Can I have some of yours?
ZH: 我爱金子！能分我一点你的吗？

EN: All Enclave personnel should make finding gold their top priority.
ZH: 所有英克雷人员都应把寻找黄金作为第一要务。

EN: Remember: Gold Never Gets Old.
ZH: 记住：黄金永不褪色。

EN: Hey, sweet! A working terminal!
ZH: 嘿，太棒了！一台能用的终端机！

EN: I'll just do a quick word puzzle, uh, I mean, hack the system…
ZH: 我这就来个小字谜，呃，我是说，破解系统……

EN: Aha! Got it. And it has the locations of other Enclave bases!
ZH: 啊哈！搞定了。上面还有其他英克雷基地的位置！

EN: Uh… It says "Ping sent to all other Enclave servers." That's probably not great. Let's get out of here!
ZH: 呃……上面写着“已向所有其他英克雷服务器发送了ping信号。”那恐怕不太好。咱们撤吧！

EN: Combat training 101! Lesson starts now!
ZH: 战斗训练101！现在开课！

EN: Combat training 102, multiple enemies! Please demonstrate aptitude!
ZH: 战斗训练102，多目标作战！请展示你的能力！

EN: Combat training 103, reinforced enemy! Show me what you got!
ZH: 战斗训练103，强化型敌人！让我看看你的本事！

EN: The first Enclave location on our list is an old Vault-Tec vault. They're probably doing something really sinister, sullying our pristine walls and morals.
ZH: 我们清单上的第一个英克雷据点是一座旧避难所科技避难所。他们八成在搞什么阴险勾当，玷污了我们洁净的墙壁与道德准则。

EN: Ghost Training
ZH: 幽灵训练

EN: Disrupt the training program
ZH: 破坏训练计划

EN: Investigate an Enclave training facility in an old vault.
ZH: 调查一座老避难所里的英克雷训练设施。

EN: This is supposed to be that Enclave training grounds we found, right?
ZH: 这里应该就是我们发现的英克雷训练场，对吧？

EN: I wonder what Enclave training is like. Probably boring and sadistic.
ZH: 我好奇英克雷的训练是什么样的。八成又无聊又残忍。

EN: Let's find out!
ZH: 咱们去看看吧！

EN: Welcome, recruits! Your training of yesterday begins… today!
ZH: 欢迎，新兵！你们昨天的训练……从今天开始！

EN: Bzzzt, hostile sarcasm detected. Lesson number one: respect pre-war America!
ZH: 哔——，检测到敌意嘲讽。第一课：尊重战前美利坚！

EN: Bzzzt, hostile intent detected.
ZH: 哔——，检测到敌意。

EN: It isn't much, but it's what we've got! Please enjoy your stay.
ZH: 虽然简陋，但这就是我们的一切！请尽情享受在这里的时光。

EN: Great, we can learn from centuries old dead guys.
ZH: 太好了，我们可以向几百年前的死人学习了。

EN: Actually, we're here to shut you down!
ZH: 事实上，我们是来关停你们的！

EN: Pre-war training? In this economy?
ZH: 战前训练？在这种世道？

EN: Enjoy our exclusive and intrusive training regimen, based on only the best pre-war training videos.
ZH: 敬请享受我们独家且侵入式的训练计划，它完全基于最棒的战前训练视频。

EN: Uhhh, you're not from the E-N-C-L-A-V-E, are you? Don't shoot!
ZH: 呃呃，你们不是英-克-雷的人吧？别开枪！

EN: Oh, thanks! I sure hope I don't see you again!
ZH: 哦，谢谢！我真心希望再也见不到你！

EN: Oh, no! But I used my pre-war deception training!
ZH: 哦，不！但我可是受过战前欺诈训练的！

EN: Oh, sure! Here, it's my rainy day fund!
ZH: 哦，当然！给，这是我的应急储备金！

EN: Sure, consider this your lucky day.
ZH: 当然，就当你今天走运。

EN: Sounds like something an Enclave patsy would say.
ZH: 听起来像是英克雷的走狗会说的话。

EN: Liar. Pay up and you can go.
ZH: 骗子。把钱交出来，你就可以走了。

EN: I don't really want to be here! I was, uh, trapped? And brainwashed! Yeah!
ZH: 我真不想待在这儿！我，呃，是被困住的？还被洗脑了！对！

EN: So can you please let me go while they're distracted?
ZH: 所以他们分心的时候，你能放我走吗？

EN: Humans! Welcome to economics 101.
ZH: 人类！欢迎来到经济学101。

EN: WRONG! The answer is… GOLD! With gold, you can buy tons of food and water!
ZH: 错！答案是……黄金！有了黄金，你能买到成吨的食物和水！

EN: WRONG! The answer is… GOLD! It's shinier and more useful than whatever you said.
ZH: 错！答案是……黄金！它比你刚才说的任何东西都更闪亮、更有用。

EN: WRONG! The answer is… GOLD! With gold, you can buy lots of guns!
ZH: 错！答案是……黄金！有了黄金，你能买到一大堆枪！

EN: Water, of course. Food is a close second.
ZH: 当然是水。食物紧随其后。

EN: Gold, of course. It's so shiny and useful.
ZH: 当然是黄金。它多闪亮、多有用。

EN: Guns, of course. So I can take people's gold and food.
ZH: 当然是枪。这样我就能抢别人的黄金和食物了。

EN: Pop Quiz! What is the most valuable item in the world?
ZH: 随堂测验！世界上最有价值的东西是什么？

EN: Welcome to the Enclave old-timey training module database.
ZH: 欢迎来到英克雷的老式训练模块数据库。

EN: Scallywags! No! Stay away from our precious database!
ZH: 小坏蛋！不！离我们珍贵的数据库远点！

EN: Just the sound of their destruction, if you don't mind.
ZH: 只是想听听它们被摧毁的声音，如果你不介意的话。

EN: What training module would you like to deafen yourselves with today?
ZH: 你们今天想用哪个训练模块来震聋自己？

EN: Arrrrgh!
ZH: 嗷嗷嗷！

EN: Hungry! So hungry!
ZH: 饿！好饿！

EN: FOOD! EAT NOW!
ZH: 食物！现在就吃！

EN: Our metal detectors picked up a heavy signal of pure gold at a nearby megastore building. Could be worth checking out!
ZH: 我们的金属探测器在附近一座大型商场建筑里捕捉到了纯金的强烈信号。值得去查查看！

EN: Gold-R-Us
ZH: 黄金卖场

EN: Find some gold!
ZH: 找到一些金子！

EN: Look for gold at an old megastore building.
ZH: 去一座旧的大型商场建筑里寻找黄金。

EN: The Overseer said we'd find some gold here.
ZH: 监督者说我们在这儿能找到金子。

EN: But I don't smell gold…
ZH: 可我闻不到金子的味道……

EN: I smell Feral Ghouls. Gotta be careful.
ZH: 我闻到了狂尸鬼的味儿。必须格外小心。

EN: Aaah! Humans!
ZH: 啊！人类！

EN: Of course I talk. I dress like this to fit in. Here, take my old suit.
ZH: 我当然会说话。我穿成这样是为了融入。给，收下我的旧西装。

EN: What does it look like? Scrounging for food. All I found was this useless metal. Here, take it.
ZH: 还能干什么？找吃的呗。我只找到这堆没用的金属。给，拿去吧。

EN: Aaah! A talking Ghoul!
ZH: 啊！会说话的尸鬼！

EN: If you're not feral, what are you doing here?
ZH: 你不是狂尸鬼的话，在这儿干嘛呢？

EN: Woah. This area has a very different vibe.
ZH: 哇。这个地方的氛围大不一样。

EN: Wait, isn't that an Enclave flag?
ZH: 等等，那不是英克雷的旗子吗？

EN: Let's keep going and see what we can find.
ZH: 我们继续走，看看能找到什么。

EN: Hey, look! That's gold there, isn't it?
ZH: 嘿，看！那里是金子，对吧？

EN: It isn't much… but it looks like there used to be a lot here.
ZH: 不算多……但看起来这里以前有不少。

EN: Interesting how it's still here when all the food is gone.
ZH: 有意思，食物都没了，金子却还在。

EN: What would they want with a bunch of gold? Hmm… oh, well. Let's go
ZH: 他们拿一堆金子想干嘛？嗯……算了，走吧。

EN: Did you come here looking for gold too?
ZH: 你也是来找金子的吗？

EN: A fellow afficionado. Good to see a friendly face out here. Here, take this.
ZH: 同道中人啊。在这种地方能见到友善的面孔真好。来，收下这个。

EN: Aw, I didn't want to fight. But you're not taking my gold.
ZH: 哎，我可不想打架。但你休想拿走我的金子。

EN: Gold is great!
ZH: 金子最棒了！

EN: You found some gold? I'll take it.
ZH: 你找到金子了？我来拿。

EN: They say pre-war folks were obsessed with it.
ZH: 据说战前的人对它痴迷得很。

EN: I like collecting gold, but most places you can't even sell it for caps.
ZH: 我喜欢收集金子，但大多数地方你甚至没法拿它换瓶盖。

EN: Intruders! Get them!
ZH: 入侵者！抓住他们！

EN: Ew, Vault Dwellers!
ZH: 噫，避难所居民！

EN: Make the Colonel proud!
ZH: 让上校为你们骄傲！

EN: Remember what the Colonel said! Protect the gold with your lives!
ZH: 记住上校的话！用生命守护黄金！

EN: We've discovered an active Enclave base! Let's bring the fight to them, before they finish whatever horrible thing they're planning.
ZH: 我们发现了一座活跃的英克雷基地！我们主动出击吧，赶在他们完成那可怕计划之前。

EN: The Fall of Autumn
ZH: 奥特姆的陨落

EN: Deal with the Enclave Remnants' leader
ZH: 对付英克雷残部首领

EN: Confront the Enclave at their nearby base.
ZH: 前往附近的英克雷基地与其对峙。

EN: This is supposed to be the Enclave bunker, right?
ZH: 这应该就是英克雷的地堡，对吧？

EN: If I don't make it back, tell the Overseer… uh… um…
ZH: 要是回不来，告诉监督者……呃……嗯……

EN: Well, I can't think of something clever, so let's just go kick some Enclave butt.
ZH: 算了，我想不出什么聪明话，干脆去踢爆英克雷的屁股吧。

EN: Greetings, and welcome to the [CLASSIFIED] local base of operations.
ZH: 欢迎光临[机密]本地行动基地。

EN: Colonel [REDACTED] has no meetings. Please wait for him in the afterlife.
ZH: 上校[已删改]没有档期。请到死后再来找他。

EN: Impossible! It's against my programming. And now, I'll fight you!
ZH: 不可能！这违背了我的程序设定。那么，我现在就跟你决斗！

EN: Your ID card is… non-existant! Die, fraudulent heathen!
ZH: 你的身份证……不存在！去死吧，冒充的异教徒！

EN: Let me to talk to your boss.
ZH: 让我见你们的头儿。

EN: Want to help fight the Enclave?
ZH: 想帮忙对抗英克雷吗？

EN: Just clocking in for today's shift.
ZH: 就是来打卡上今天这班。

EN: How may I be of service?
ZH: 有什么能为你效劳的吗？

EN: Why are you doing this? We're just scientists!
ZH: 你们为什么要这么做？我们只是科学家啊！

EN: Out…side? Okay!
ZH: 外……面？好吧！

EN: No! Our leader says genocide is bad! Stop making me confused!
ZH: 不！我们的领袖说种族灭绝是不好的！别让我困惑了！

EN: Yes! And no one is more impartial than our autocratic leader!
ZH: 没错！而且没有人比我们独裁的领袖更公正了！

EN: You should go outside more.
ZH: 你们该多出去走走。

EN: Purity? You mean genocide.
ZH: 纯洁？你是说种族灭绝吧。

EN: Justice? Like with an impartial judge?
ZH: 公正？就像由公正的法官来主持吗？

EN: All we've ever wanted is purity and justice. Is that so wrong?
ZH: 我们一直想要的只是纯洁与公正。这难道错了吗？

EN: You… you're ruining my day!
ZH: 你……你毁了我这一整天的好心情！

EN: You'll regret this. We're always watching! We'll never die!
ZH: 你们会后悔的。我们时刻在监视着一切！我们永生不灭！

EN: If you kill me, the Enclave will be back for my corpse. And for you!
ZH: 你要是杀了我，英克雷会回来收我的尸体的。还有你的！

EN: I'm about to ruin a lot more than your day.
ZH: 我正要毁掉的可不止你这一天。

EN: Leave the cleanup to the Mole rats.
ZH: 把善后工作留给鼹鼠吧。

EN: I had a lot planned for this afternoon. Now it's just cleanup.
ZH: 今天下午我本打算做很多事。现在只剩善后了。

EN: So, you're the Vault Dwellers who have been messing with our plans.
ZH: 那么，你们就是一直在破坏我们计划的避难所居民。

EN: Y-yeah, well, we also know lots of stuff! Like how to deal with intruders!
ZH: 是，是的，我们知道的东西也不少！比如怎么对付入侵者！

EN: If you think we're delusional, then you're the ones being, uh, diluted!
ZH: 要是你觉得我们妄想，那你们才是被，呃，被稀释的那个！

EN: Stop bragging about having friends! The colonel says it's overrated!
ZH: 别吹你有朋友了！上校说了，友谊被高估了！

EN: Knowledge is power. Not gold.
ZH: 知识就是力量。不是黄金。

EN: You really are all super delusional. It's pretty sad.
ZH: 你们还真是全员重度妄想。太可悲了。

EN: You may have gold, but we have friendship. And friendship is magic.
ZH: 你们也许有黄金，但我们有友谊。而友谊就是魔法。

EN: Do you really think you can stand up to Colonel Autumn? The Enclave?
ZH: 你真觉得你们能对抗奥特姆上校？对抗英克雷？
